name: OAuth: redirect capture -> state abuse -> token theft
goal: Turn OAuth flow weaknesses (redirect_uri scope, missing state, open redirectors) into full account takeover of victim sessions.
preconditions: OAuth login or account-linking flow present.
impact: Authorization codes/tokens delivered to attacker-controlled origins; victims' accounts linked to attacker identities.

steps.purpose: Prove the provider accepts attacker-controlled origins in redirect_uri (suffix/path/@ tricks).
steps.on_success: Codes/tokens can be steered; combine step 3 for a legit-looking hop.
steps.on_fail: Exact-match enforced -> subdomain takeover of an allow-listed origin (chain subdomain-takeover-sweep) is the premium bypass.

steps.purpose: CSRF on the flow: bind victims to attacker codes (login CSRF / account linking takeover).
steps.on_success: Victim completes flow -> attacker account linkage.
steps.on_fail: State present but reusable -> replay within TTL; PKCE absent -> code interception becomes viable.

steps.purpose: Use the site's own redirector as redirect_uri to make a wildcard allow-list exploitable.
steps.on_success: Chained redirect keeps provenance legit while landing codes on your origin.
steps.on_fail: No open redirect -> postMessage/referer-leak variants (documented) or implicit-flow token leakage.

steps.purpose: Finalization: tokens/cookies exposed to JS make the takeover persistent in browser context.
steps.on_success: Script-side capture completes the ATO story.
steps.on_fail: HttpOnly set -> XSS-based capture (web/XSS reflected HTML-context) is the alternative collector.

recon.name: Allow-list cartography
recon.how: Enumerate every accepted redirect_uri value by error-message diffing; collect wildcards and legacy entries.

recon.name: Bypass pattern sweep
recon.how: Try /path traversal, %2f, @attacker, sub-suffix (evil-target.tld), dot- inserting encodings.

recon.name: State & PKCE audit
recon.how: Strip/replay state, check code_challenge binding, try re-used codes.

recon.name: Implicit/fragment audit
recon.how: response_type=token flows leak fragments to referers/analytics scripts.
recon.signal: Token in location.hash handled by third-party JS.

recon.name: Takeover pairing
recon.how: Check allow-listed origins for dead CNAMEs — takeover converts an exact-match allow-list into attacker origin.

pivot_hints: jwt-to-privilege if provider and app share token verification
